levels.text: Recoil Roll: the shot throws you back a dash (90 px), evading for 400 ms

name: Recoil Roll
notes: One rare level. The shot's recoil is the player's own dash (Skills::Charge, 90 px at speed 14, no dash charge spent) backwards along the shot line, with the dash's roll animation, plus the snipe_recoil buff: 100% evade for 400 ms (the roll takes about 210 ms). Marksman.as HWPFirearmsSnipeRecoil; the orb swaps Snipe's class. The user's item of 2026-10-22.
summary: Firing the Sniper Shot pushes you backwards in a dodge roll, invulnerable while you roll.
